t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ninjuliza Iwe Katonda wange, okwo Niwe wantonzile Inye kukumanya kandi noukuabudu Iwe. Ninjuliza akanya aka, ombujege bwange kandi nomumani Gawe, no omubunaku bwange kandi nomubutungi Bwawe. Taliyo Katonda ondijo shana Iwe, Omujuni omunaku, Nyakubaho.
